units.source_text: 信辅交朋友的原则是对方必须有才能。

en.t: Shinsuke's principle in making friends was that the other person had to possess talent.

units.source_text: 标准也就只有这个罢了。

en.t: That was the only standard he had.

units.source_text: 不过，那个标准也不是没有例外的时候。

en.t: However, even that standard was not without its exceptions.

units.source_text: 那就是切断他和朋友之间友情的阶级差别。

en.t: Those exceptions were the class differences that cut off the friendship between him and his friends.

units.source_text: 信辅跟和他生长环境相同的中产阶级青年中间，没有任何隔阂。

en.t: Between Shinsuke and the middle-class youths who had grown up in the same sort of environment as he had, there was no barrier at all.

units.source_text: 但是，跟和他不熟悉的上流阶级青年，有时候也会对中流上层阶级的青年，产生像陌生人一样的难以置信的憎恨干。

en.t: But toward upper-class youths unfamiliar to him, and sometimes even toward youths of the upper middle class, he felt an unbelievable hatred, as if they were complete strangers.

units.source_text: 这些人当中，有些人生性懒惰，有些人生性怯懦，有些人好色纵欲。

en.t: Among these people, some were lazy by nature, some were cowardly by nature, and some were lustful and self-indulgent.

units.source_text: 但是，他不仅仅是因为这些原因憎恶他们。

en.t: But it was not only for these reasons that he detested them.

units.source_text: 不，毋宁说是憎恨他们那种不知所谓的漠然态度。

en.t: No, rather, he hated that incomprehensible indifference of theirs.

units.source_text: 其实，他最憎恨的还是他们自己也没意识到的那种说不清的“不知所谓”。

en.t: In truth, what he hated most was that indescribable incomprehensibility of theirs, something they themselves did not even notice.

units.source_text: 正是因为这样，他对下层阶级——跟他们阶级相反的人群，有种几乎病态的关怀。

en.t: Precisely because of this, he had an almost morbid concern for the lower classes, the people opposite to their class.
Shinsuke was full of sympathy for them.

units.source_text: 当然，这种同情毫无用处。

en.t: Of course, this sympathy was of no use at all.

units.source_text: 每次跟那些说不清的“不知所谓”的人握手的时候，他都觉得如针刺手。

en.t: Every time he shook hands with those indescribably incomprehensible people, he felt as though needles were pricking his hand.

units.source_text: 记得在四月的某个午后，寒风凛冽，当时还在上高中的信辅和他的同学——一位男爵家的长子，一起伫立在江之岛的断崖之上。

en.t: He remembered one afternoon in April, when a bitter wind was blowing, standing on the cliffs of Enoshima with his classmate, the eldest son of a baronial family, while Shinsuke was still in high school.

units.source_text: 脚下就是波涛汹涌的海岸线。

en.t: Below their feet lay a coastline where the waves surged violently.

units.source_text: 他们往海里扔几个铜板，让几个少年“潜水”去捞。

en.t: They threw a few copper coins into the sea and had several boys dive for them.

units.source_text: 每当铜板落入海中，少年就相继“扑通，扑通……”的跳进海里。

en.t: Whenever the copper coins fell into the water, the boys jumped into the sea one after another with splashes of plop, plop.

units.source_text: 然而，有一个海女站在断崖下焚烧干海草的火堆前，笑着眺望海面。

en.t: Yet one ama stood below the cliff before a fire where dried seaweed was being burned, smiling as she gazed out over the surface of the sea.
